product_metadata.title: Home-Complete Large Ice Molds Silicone Trays Makes 8, 2”x 2” Big Cubes BPA-Free, Flexible-Chill Water, Lemonade, Cocktails, and More, Black(Pack Of 2)
features: SET OF 2 SILICONE MOLDS- Constructed from strong and durable silicone, these long-lasting trays are BPA-free and dishwasher safe. The leak-free freezer trays are also flexible for easy release of the ice.
8 ICE CUBES- The trays have 8 molds each to create 2” x 2” x 2” cubes; these giant ice cubes will melt more slowly than small ice cubes, keeping your drink refreshingly cold for longer!

MULTI-PURPOSE- The oversized ice cubes are perfect for chilling water, lemonade, tea, liquors, mixed drinks, and more. They are also a great way to pre-portion out homemade chocolates, baby foods, or to make ice pops with!

GREAT GIFT- Not only are these cool giant ice trays sure to be a hit at your next cocktail party, event or weeknight dinner, they also make a great gift for holidays, graduations, housewarmings, or any occasion!
PRODUCT DETAILS- Materials: food safe Silicone. Dimensions: Trays-8.25”x 4.75”x 2”, Cubes: 2”x 2” x 2”. Each tray makes 8 cubes; each cube can hold approximately 3oz. water. Set of 2.
description: The Large Ice Cube Trays by Home-Complete provide a fun and practical way to chill your beverages!
